requirements.statement: Twelve failed physical preparation-folder removals retain the folder, slot, byte reservations and live memory holds; attempt thirteen observes actual removal before retirement. A missing child exception is not workspace removal proof.

Preparation cleanup retries continue indefinitely with monotone one-to-sixty-second capped backoff, no early requests and bounded retry state. Pending cleanup retains its live custodian across the automatic idle replacement boundary; replacement resumes after observed removal.

Status and the terminal warning list plainly say a preparation folder could not be removed, background retries continue and its slot remains held. Clear the warning after removal and expose no private path or exception text.
